test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Countries like China and the United States invest ___________ in wind, hydro, solar and biofuels.
solution:
The correct answer is "**heavily**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This is because the sentence is talking about the **level of investment** made by countries like China and the United States in various renewable energy sources, such as wind, hydro, solar and biofuels.
 
• The word "**heavily**" indicates **a large amount or degree** of investment, which fits the context of the sentence.

**Correct sentence**__: *Countries like China and the United States invest **heavily** in wind, hydro, solar and biofuels.*

Thus, ***option 1*** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• "**profoundly**" means deeply
 
• "**absolutely**" means completely or entirely
 
• "**achingly**" means with great pain or sorrow

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• "heavily" का अर्थ एक बड़ी राशि या डिग्री है
 
• "profoundly" का अर्थ है गहरा
 
• "absolutely" का अर्थ है पूरी तरह या पूरी तरह से
 
• "achingly" का अर्थ है बहुत दर्द या दुःख के साथ

36:Td00,

The correct answer is "**appreciate**"
